verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an official SDK is a single Node.js adapter (Keycloak Node.js Connect) listed under the keycloak GitHub organization. The Admin REST API, the kcadm CLI and the standard OIDC endpoints are building blocks or adjacent tooling, not SDKs. Missing for 10: documented official SDKs across multiple languages, SDK reference documentation, an admin-API client SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
